description: Header file defining the QuicServerSessionBase class, a server-specific subclass of QuicSpdySession for managing QUIC server sessions, including configuration, crypto streams, bandwidth estimation, and connection handling.

classes.name: QuicServerSessionBase
classes.description: A server-specific subclass of QuicSpdySession managing QUIC server sessions, including crypto streams, bandwidth estimation, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: QuicServerSessionBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server session with configuration, supported versions, connection, visitor, helper, crypto config, and certs cache.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles connection closure, overriding base class to cancel ongoing asynchronous crypto.

methods.name: OnBandwidthUpdateTimeout
methods.description: Overrides to send bandwidth estimate updates.

methods.name: OnCongestionWindowChange
methods.description: Sends server config update with new bandwidth estimate.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session.

methods.name: crypto_stream
methods.description: Returns the current crypto stream.

methods.name: OnConfigNegotiated
methods.description: Processes bandwidth-related configuration received from the client.

methods.name: set_serving_region
methods.description: Sets the server's serving region string.

methods.name: serving_region
methods.description: Returns the server's serving region string.

methods.name: GetSSLConfig
methods.description: Retrieves SSL configuration.

methods.name: enable_sending_bandwidth_estimate_when_network_idle
methods.description: Checks if bandwidth estimate should be sent when network is idle.

methods.name: GetMutableCryptoStream
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the crypto stream.

methods.name: GetCryptoStream
methods.description: Returns a const pointer to the crypto stream.

methods.name: GenerateCachedNetworkParameters
methods.description: Generates cached network parameters for bandwidth estimation.

methods.name: ShouldCreateOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Determines if an outgoing bidirectional stream can be created.

methods.name: ShouldCreateOutgoingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Determines if an outgoing unidirectional stream can be created.

methods.name: ShouldCreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Determines if an incoming stream should be created based on stream ID.

methods.name: CreateQuicCryptoServerStream
methods.description: Creates a new crypto server stream (abstract method).

methods.name: crypto_config
methods.description: Returns the crypto configuration used by the session.

methods.name: stream_helper
methods.description: Returns the helper used for creating crypto streams.
